subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Emma (and team),

Thanks again for taking time today - great conversation and a clear sense of the committee priorities. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

What we heard (stakeholder mapping):
- Product/UX: Emma Collins (you) - primary user and champion for reducing time-to-insight in search.
- Security: Tom Rivera - will lead the security review (data flow, encryption, SOC2).
- Procurement: Jill Park - contract and SOW ownership.
- Economic buyer: Mike Donovan (CFO) - not on this thread but was mentioned as final approver; timeline for his review will be key.

Decision criteria you called out: accuracy on short answers, latency < 150ms P95, multi-region data residency (US + EU for future), SOC2 + attestations, predictable unit economics.

Key asks / next steps (proposed):
1) Security deep-dive: Rafael to run a focused session with Tom to cover architecture, logs, key management, and data residency. Rafael, can you propose 2 slots?
2) Procurement: share MSA + template SOW and a short list of references. Jill, please confirm any specific legal contract terms we should anticipate.
3) Commercial: Connor and I to provide a ballpark pricing worksheet and pilot proposal (30-day pilot + success metrics).
4) Timeline: Emma - can you confirm target decision window (they mentioned late July in the demo)?

Attached: ACME-MAP-v1.pdf (stakeholder map / internal alignment doc).

If everyone agrees with the plan I'll schedule the technical deep-dive for next week.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@acmecorp.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this is helpful and mirrors our notes. A few clarifications from our side:  

Decision criteria (priority order):
- Cost per inference (total cost of ownership over pilot and annualized)
- Security/compliance: SOC2 attestation + ability to keep logs in our VPC (or equivalent)
- Latency/availability SLA (P95 < 150ms, target 99.95% uptime)
- Model quality on our prompt set (we'll share a small eval set)

Timeline: yes - target decision by the end of July, assuming no major legal holds. Procurement (Jill) will lead contracting and needs the MSA + SOW + pricing worksheet.

Rafael - please prioritize the session with Tom; it would be ideal to cover KMS options, audit logs retention, and how you handle model rollbacks/fallbacks.

I'm attaching a short procurement checklist (procurement_questions.xlsx) so you can see our standard asks.

Emma
Product Lead, Acme Corp
emma.collins@acmecorp.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmecorp.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks - happy to run the security/architecture deep-dive. Proposed slots (45 min):
- Tue 2026-06-22, 10:00-10:45am PT
- Wed 2026-06-23, 2:00-2:45pm PT

Agenda I suggest: brief architecture overview (10 min), traffic pattern and KV/prefix caching (10 min), KMS & audit logs (10 min), quantization/latency optimizations and fallback strategy (10 min), Q&A (5 min).

Two quick asks to tailor the session:
1) Approx expected QPS and peak concurrent requests during pilot (ballpark is fine).
2) Typical sequence length (avg and 95th pct) for the prompts you'll be using.

Attaching inference_arch.pdf (high-level runtime diagram + dataflow) - I'll have a more detailed runbook ready for the deep-dive.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

From: Jill Park <jill.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Emma Collins <emma.collins@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Marissa / Emma,

Thanks for the recap. Procurement side - a few items we need to move forward:  
- Please send a copy of your standard MSA and a sample SOW we can use to scope a 30-day pilot.
- We require three references of customers running production inference (name, contact, short use case).
- Any SOC2 attestation / compliance artifacts you can share up front would be helpful.

If you can provide the MSA + SOW and references by next Thursday (2026-06-24) that would keep us on track for late-July decision.

Thanks,
Jill Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jill Park <jill.park@acmecorp.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Appreciate the quick responses - we can absolutely get everything over on the timeline you requested. Concrete next steps from Redwood:  

- Commercial worksheet & pilot proposal: Connor and I will send a pricing worksheet + 30-day pilot SOW by EOD 2026-06-19.
- MSA & SOW: attaching SOW-template.docx here and a link to our standard MSA. We can mark the pilot SOW as a short-term attachment to the MSA.
- Compliance docs: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf; Rafael will surface additional compliance artifacts in the deep-dive.
- References: will share three reference contacts (enterprise inference use cases) in a follow-up by 2026-06-22.
- Technical deep-dive: Rafael to confirm the best slot; once confirmed we'll send calendar invite.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-569128 
NDA / DocuSign (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/nd/placeholder/ACME-NDA

If this plan looks good, please confirm the preferred slot for Rafael's session and we will lock things in.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Marissa Cole
